text:
I understand you'd like to return your laptop, but I need to authenticate your identity first before I can help with any order-related actions. Since you don't remember your email address, I can look you up using your name and zip code instead.

Could you please provide:
- Your zip code
- Your first name (Emma, as you mentioned)
- Your last name (Smith, as you mentioned)

Once I verify your identity, I'll be able to help you locate your laptop order and process the return.
zh:
我理解您想退回笔记本电脑，但在我帮助任何订单相关操作之前，我需要先验证您的身份。由于您不记得电子邮件地址，我可以使用您的姓名和邮编来查找您。

您能提供：
- 您的邮编
- 您的名字（艾玛，如您所说）
- 您的姓氏（史密斯，如您所说）

一旦我验证您的身份，我就能帮助您找到您的笔记本电脑订单并处理退货。
